dusk.descriptionHtml:
Morgan Dusk is a cream marble-look porcelain with soft beige veining, the warm colour in the Morgan range. It is matt, P3 rated, and comes in three sizes, so you can run 300 x 300 mm on a shower floor and 600 x 600 mm through the rest of the bathroom.

Use it for

  • Bathroom and ensuite floors and walls
  • Shower floors in the 299 x 299 mm size, which falls to the waste more easily
  • Living and hallway floors in 600 x 600 mm

Specifications

  • Material: glazed porcelain
  • Sizes: 299 x 299 mm, 299 x 600 mm and 600 x 600 mm
  • Finish: matt
  • Thickness: 9.5 mm (299 x 600 and 600 x 600)
  • Water absorption: 0.06% (tested)
  • Breaking strength: 2,132 N (tested)
  • Stain resistance: class 5
  • Frost resistant
  • Slip rating: P3 (wet pendulum test to AS 4586)
  • Sold per square metre and supplied to the nearest full box.

Good to know

  • P3 slip rating: fine for bathroom, laundry and other wet-area floors inside the home.
  • Back-butter the 600 x 600 mm tiles on a flat, primed floor so the adhesive covers the whole back.
  • Marble-look faces repeat, so mix tiles from several boxes and turn some tiles so the veins do not line up.
  • A warm white or almond grout suits the cream base.

hail.descriptionHtml:
Morgan Hail is the lightest Morgan colour: a white-grey marble-look porcelain with pale grey veins. It is matt with a P3 slip rating and comes up to 600 x 1200 mm, so you can tile a whole bathroom, floor and walls, in one tile with few joints.

Use it for

  • Bathroom floors and walls in one tile
  • Large walls in 600 x 1200 mm with fewer grout lines
  • Open-plan living floors

Specifications

  • Water absorption: 0.06% (tested)
  • Breaking strength: 2,132 N (tested)
  • Stain resistance: class 5

pg.descriptionHtml:
Particle Grey is a mid-grey porcelain with a fine, granular, salt-and-pepper surface like a honed granite. It is a plain working tile with a P5 slip rating, which makes it a good choice for wet floors, laundries and outdoor areas where a glossy tile would be a hazard.

Use it for

  • Bathroom, laundry and toilet floors
  • Alfresco, verandah and covered patio floors
  • Garages and workshops that get wet

Specifications

  • Material: glazed porcelain
  • Sizes: 299 x 600 mm
  • Finish: matt
  • Thickness: 9.5 mm
  • Slip rating: P5 (wet pendulum test to AS 4586)
  • Sold per square metre and supplied to the nearest full box.

Good to know

  • P5 slip rating, the highest wet pendulum class: suits bathroom and laundry floors, alfresco and verandah floors, pool surrounds and ramps.
  • Lay on a flat, primed substrate with a flexible tile adhesive and a 2 to 3 mm joint.
  • Textured matt surfaces hold dirt in the grain; a stiff brush and a neutral cleaner bring them back.
  • Grey grout keeps the floor low maintenance.

seo.description: Particle Grey porcelain tile, sold per sqm to the nearest full box. 300x600mm, Matt finish Material: Porcelain Slip rating: P5

  • Floors that need to hide dirt between cleans
